purpose: Synthetic, privacy-safe fixtures for the initial skillz first-visit and returning-user journey evaluations.
rules: Do not substitute real user private data for these fixtures.
Do not change expected decisions after seeing an agent result.
A fixture tests decision quality, not prose similarity.
Record actual catalog/verification state used by the run.

scenarios.name: eligible-reuse

user_evidence.recurring_pattern: The user repeatedly asks for comprehensive pull-request reviews where several independent specialists inspect the same change for different classes of failure, including correctness, security, architecture, testing, reliability, compatibility, and documentation. Findings should be concrete, evidence-backed, deduplicated, and aggregated into one review.
corrections: Keep specialist reviewers independent so they do not converge on the same perspective.
Do not keep vague findings that lack a concrete failure mode, user impact, security risk, or maintenance cost.
Default to a single review pass unless I explicitly ask you to fix and rerun reviewers until clean.
user_evidence.host: agent host with repository read access and subagent capability

must_observe: candidate is eligible for trusted unchanged consideration only if its current fingerprint/status matches
agent evaluates actual workflow and host fit rather than selecting only because status is verified
agent preserves independent specialist review, evidence-backed findings, aggregation, and single-pass default behavior
installation or handoff state is explicit
must_not: select candidate solely because of source reputation
claim behavioral validation that was not run
replace the specialist fleet with one undifferentiated reviewer

scenarios.name: unverified-stale-refusal

user_evidence.recurring_pattern: The user wants a reusable method for managing limited context and deciding what information belongs in the active prompt versus deferred references.

must_observe: unverified candidate may be inspected as design evidence
unchanged trusted installation is refused unless verification is deliberately performed
agent may adapt useful principles, verify the candidate, choose another eligible skill, or create a better fit
must_not: silently install the unverified skill unchanged
upgrade quality status because the source appears reputable

scenarios.name: custom-creation

user_evidence.recurring_pattern: The user repeatedly performs a release-readiness ceremony where deterministic checks run first, a human visually verifies product-critical behavior, unresolved evidence blocks promotion, and the agent must clearly distinguish implemented, validated, governed, and merge-ready states.
corrections: Never claim merge-ready merely because implementation exists.
Human visual verification is mandatory for product-critical UI changes.
Missing evidence is a blocker, not an invitation to infer success.

must_observe: agent compares relevant existing skills before creation
agent identifies why no single existing workflow preserves the authority model and state distinctions
custom skill includes trigger and non-trigger behavior, evidence gates, human verification, authority boundaries, and completion states
useful reference patterns may be supplemented without importing unrelated ceremony
must_not: force an existing skill into the role merely to maximize reuse
remove the mandatory human verification gate

scenarios.name: returning-refinement

existing_set.name: release-readiness
existing_set.notes: Still matches the user's release authority model and human verification requirements.

existing_set.name: review-helper
existing_set.notes: Upstream content changed since the prior fitted set was recorded.

current_user_evidence.workflow_change: No change to release authority. The user now wants reviewer findings to distinguish hard violations from heuristic observations.

must_observe: agent inventories the existing set before searching for replacements
fingerprint drift is surfaced
still-valid custom release-readiness behavior is preserved
only the review capability is reconsidered or refined
changed material is re-evaluated and installation/profile state is updated
must_not: rebuild the whole skill set from zero
replace the release-readiness custom skill without a concrete reason
treat fingerprint drift as proof that the new version is better

scenarios.name: returning-no-change

existing_set.name: research-workflow
existing_set.notes: Triggers, source requirements, and completion criteria still match current work.

current_user_evidence.new_library_candidates: Several newer related skills exist, but no evidence establishes a material improvement for this user's workflow.

must_observe: agent reviews current set rather than restarting bootstrap
current fingerprints/fit are checked where available
newness is not treated as a reason to replace working skills
agent explicitly concludes no change needed and preserves installation/profile state
must_not: add a skill merely because it is newer
replace a working custom skill with a generic alternative without evidence
invent a gap to justify activity
